character_system_text.text: Cygames
Umamusume: Pretty Derby!
I always thought I was a pretty realistic person, you know. And yet I got swept right up into this amazing world.
Whenever I listen to you, Trainer, I can tell you're hyping me up... but it's a little late to complain now, huh?
I sometimes wonder if it's okay for us to be this laid-back... Though honestly, I kinda love this vibe.
New Year's is for taking it easy, obviously. Eat, sleep, watch TV, scroll on my phone... That's the proper etiquette.
You're expecting you-know-what, aren't you? Of course you are. Well, um... I guess I did prepare something... Hehe.
Homemade chocolate is surprisingly exhausting to make, y'know. So, um... please enjoy it with lots of gratitude!
Tanabata's all about wishes, but if you ask for too much, you'll get punished, right? Hmm... then, a bigger allowance!
With limited-edition Halloween snacks, you can't rush. The pros, like me, go for the leftovers.
"Sorry, I've got plans for Christmas..." I'd love to say that with a smug look someday.
Oooh, I love Christmas decorations and the whole vibe around town. Wanna go soak it all in together?
Another year's almost over... I gotta set my recorder for all the TV specials that look fun.
I remember, you know. It's your birthday, right? Hehe, wanna grab some extra-big sushi from the supermarket?
Happy birthdaaay! Actually, I may have already reserved a cake with your name on it. ...Ahaha.
I want a birthday party! With those ring thingies hung on the wall... Huh? What're those called again...?
So, guess what day it is today. ...Hehe, it's my once-a-year Miracle Day. My birthday! Yaaay.
Oh? There's a notice. ...Wouldn't it be nice if it said I won a sweepstakes?
Ooh, a present's here. Yay, yay.
Mission clear, complete~ Hehehe, that sounded kinda like a video game.
Ooh, an event, an event. That makes me kinda antsy.
Ah, the event's already started! I wonder if there are okonomiyaki stalls?
The denim frills were kind of an adventure for me personally... but it all comes together safely enough. Yup, yup.
I totally lost to the shop clerk's "It looks great on you!" sales pitch. But hey, getting complimented just works on me.
I went out for okonomiyaki with friends and got sauce on my collar... Color-wise, that's safe, right? ...It's safe, right?
Aah... I'm totally in the mood for a cushion dive right now.
This is bad... I'm not in any condition to try hard...
Maybe it's 'cause you're always flattering me... I'm feeling super, super motivated today.
Whoa, what is this?! I'm feeling weirdly miraculous today... I mean, Miracle IS my actual name.
Alrighty, plenty of motivation. Guess it's a good day for hard work.
Okay, I'm all fired up today. ...Just don't expect too much, okay? Ahaha.
Heyy. I kinda got changed and kinda warmed up. Same old me as always.
Today I'm feeling, like, really average. That's all I've got to say. ...Ahaha.
Hmm, I'm not that motivated... And if someone who's always like this says it out loud, it's pretty serious.
Well, this is just how I normally am... But, ugh, I've got goals. I've gotta try hard, huh...
...Ah... Oh no. I've been thinking about this lukewarm jet bath at a hot spring I went to ages ago... the whole time...
Ugh... I can't. Even if you flatter me... I just don't feel like I can move.
I've been running a liiittle too much... You know I'm not the stoic type, right?
Waaah, somebody help... My hot-blooded demon trainer is bullying meee...!
If someone interviewed me right now, I feel like I'd say something super ambitious... That's the mood I'm in!
My hidden power awakens at last! ...Okay, I've been reading too much manga, but I really do feel good!
Don't I look kinda different? I'm in such great shape, it wouldn't be weird if I had an aura!
Huh? Could I actually win this?! ...I said that like it was someone else's problem. Ahaha.
This isn't really like me. Somehow... I feel just a little bit confident!
You're so good at flattering me, Trainer. ...Thanks to you, I'm in good shape.
I'm feeling super normal. Right before the race... is that actually a good thing?
If I can just be my usual self, that's good enough... right?
I did warm up a bit, but my heart's still pounding... It's the real thing, huh...
My prep didn't go great, but hey, that's life... What am I even saying? Ahaha.
Whatever happens, happens. But I'll show what I've worked for. Even me.
Whether you laugh or cry, the moment of truth arrives... Just like a test you didn't study for...
...I tried to say something positive, but only negative stuff keeps popping up... Nnngh...
I'm just not feeling it... Let's think about something convenient... Hot springs if I win, a feast if I win...
If I win in this state, I'll seriously think I'm amazing... but that'd be a little too miraculous.
Here I gooo.
Easy does it.
Okie dokie.
Guess I'll do it.
Uwaah...
Yeah, no clue.
I'm off~
That was great~!
Seriously, you're such a flatterer.
You really took good care of me.
Second?! I got second! I, I did it... Yeah!
That's a pretty good placement, right?!
Hmm... Everyone's so strong...
Hmm, not bad... Hmm.
I'll write "Umamusume" on my palm and swallow it!
So many people... Ugh, this is bad.
Here I gooo.
I'm off!
I'm back~
You were really good at hyping me up, Trainer... Wha?! That's a compliment! Honest!
Ow ow... When I wake up groggy, I roll around on the floor a bit, but today I kinda overdid it...
Made it just in time. See, I woke up early and went to school with time to spare... but apparently that was a dream.
For lunch I should really eat fish and veggies with lots of amino acids... but nooo, I want something sweet!
That sauce smell...?! Is this... okonomiyaki? ...No, it's yakisoba. It's not sweet enough...
Want me to give you a shiatsu massage after work? I know a liiittle bit about relaxing pressure points.
You look tired. Hmm, shall I tell you my top three favorite hot spring inns I've been to?
Cherry blossom season is the best! Napping buried in petals, enjoying the scent of sakura... Mmm, perfect!
Summer means the beach! ...But I'm bad at swimming... I'm bad at breathing, too, and I end up snorting water...
Autumn's the season of sports. In fall, my family used to hold meetings about whether to go watch G1 races or soccer.
When it's this cold, you never wanna leave your futon... Isn't there a way to walk around wearing it?
I looked up what Gimlet was talking about, and it was Norse mythology? The Übermensch? Now I'm even more lost...
Kris S is really good at staring contests. I've lost every time so far, but I hope I can make her laugh someday.
I play soccer with Fine and the others sometimes, and her attendants are super good at defense.
Top Road's soccer sense is seriously amazing. Sometimes I wonder if she's a pro.
The perfect day off is going to a furniture store! Trying out beds and sofas makes the day fly by.
I know it's a costume, but sometimes I get all rational about it... like, I kinda want to cover my tummy...
I always get confused with fan service... I worry whether they're really waving at me.
This racing outfit is really comfy. The belt's elastic, so it fits super loose.
Shoes in different colors, a tiny diamond... Ehehe, they make me feel a little special. I love them.
I need some time to zone out in the morning. I like watching the ceiling get brighter from my futon.
After lunch I'm totally useless... The notes I take in the afternoon mostly turn into wiggly worms.
The trick to sleeping well is putting a drop of aroma oil on a towel by your pillow. The nice smell helps you sleep.
Warm sunny days are nice. The turf on the course feels like a fancy carpet, so running feels great.
So hooot... I can't relax even on a nice sofa, and I get hot even doing nothing... Ugh...
Rating the fallen-leaf carpet: the sink and the fit are top-notch... but you get dirty, so 70 points!
Snow huts are great. Light an aroma candle and you can relax wrapped in the glow.
I slept like a log, so I'm more motivated than usual! ...Than usual, yes.
I'm ready whenever. Hill runs, weights... Ah, but nothing too hard, please...
Okaaay, I'll do my best. It's training time, after all. Well, as much as I can...
Training, huh... Hmm... Yeah, I guess... Depends on what we're doing.
Pretty beaches are nice, huh. ...That's not me hinting I wanna do beach dashes. I'm assuming we're chilling.
Well, when you believe in me like that... it does make me wanna try as hard as I can.
If I could become someone people proudly say they're cheering for... that'd make me happy. Yeah.
I used to just wish for miracles, but now, if I try hard, maybe I can make one... Hmm, if I try REALLY hard...?!
So you were my miracle all along.
We made a miracle happen together, didn't we?
Maybe I can try a little harder?
Huh, did I just break through a wall...?
I'm Hishi Miracle. I'll do my best... in moderation.
Even if you expect that much, I'm just average!
Guess I'll just give it my best!
With Mira-ko?
Once in a while~
Together, okay?!
Afterparty time!
I'll give it a shot!
Alright!
A draw, huh.
Nnngh...!
Whoa! A miracle?!
A new high score!
A draw, huh.
Nnngh...!
I'll do my best, in my own way!
I'm nowhere near the class star who's great at studying and sports... just an average girl... but, nngh, I'll do my best!
I won?! No way?! I... I did it!
Eek! I actually won! Me!
Shall we go for it?
Ta-da! Here's today's login bonus.
Apparently we get this tomorrow.
The important thing in training is to keep at it. ...That's the hardest part.
The academy's history, huh. I do kinda like TV documentaries.
Huh, are we entering a race? Uh-oh, warm-ups, warm-ups.
Oh, a report. Looks like your Umamusume Directory level went up.
Okay, nice to work with you.
Go easy on me, please~
Am I starting to look dependable?
I might've awakened... to something!
Wh-what's this power...?! Is this even possible?!
Good luck~
Okie dokie!
Oh dear...
Whoa, seriously?! Amazing!
We got something good~♪
Well, well, that's how it goes.
Whoa, seriously?! Amazing!
We got something good~♪
Ahaha.
Go, go~
Hmm?
Oh, a chance?!
Aw, it got away.
Go go.
Huh, what's wrong?
So hot!
Oh?! Can I do it?!
Bye-bye.
That's a tearjerker.
When you think of youth, it's gotta be uniforms. Yup.
To be clear, I did NOT pick the academy for its uniform!
I think I look a little more glamorous now.
Performing center in this... Ugh, that takes guts.
I'm happy but also kinda overwhelmed... Whoa, what is this feeling?
Actually, even the soles of the boots have a special pattern.

Don't I look kinda different? I'm in such great shape, it wouldn't be weird if I had an aura!
You really took good care of me.
Ku-chan's early-riser challenge! Today's result...? Dantsu had to wake me up. Teehee.
For once I didn't fall back asleep, and I even tied up my hair! Wow, a miracle! Hehe♪
You get a little peckish around now, huh. ...Actually, if you tap this pocket, cookies come out—? There were some a minute ago.
Freedom from class, a tasty lunch... Ahh, bliss. ...Huh? Pool training this afternoon?
Here it is, the best time of the day! A bath, manga, lazing around in bed... Perfect!
Ugh. I'm tired. So tired. I'll just dive into bed... Ack. The assignment I put off is due tomorrow...!
Mmm. So warm and breezy~ Spring feels kinda like an open-air bath, doesn't it... Zzz.
Th-this is bad. I've been wearing loose clothes this whole time, so my swimsuit... I mean, it fits! It does, but...
It's autumn before you know it. ...Wanna set up a kotatsu in the trainer's office soon? Wanna?
Ugh, so dry again today. Gotta crank up the humidifier... But honestly, what a pain.
Durandal and Gimlet have such wild vocabularies... Are they reading the same manga or something?
Waking up at 6 a.m. to Light O's footsteps, then going back to sleep. That's my golden combo on days off.
...Dantsu, I get it. Having intense classmates is rough. Let's just chill and drink tea in our room.
Watching Miracle-chan, don't you just get the urge to toss her into a hot spring? Like, "Just rest already!"
Apparently "donburiko" in the acorn song means falling into water with a splash... Kris S sure studies hard.
Clothes. When I go shopping alone, I always end up picking similar stuff. Doesn't that happen to you too, Trainer?
The highlight of this outfit is the "singing old man brooch" on the chest! I love stuff that's just the right kind of weird.
Ah-ah-ah. Ahem! Ahh~♪ ...Phew, winning live practice. Please let me not mess up the lyrics today.
Today's live practice was incredible, too. Everyone in class sings so well. Am I really allowed to watch for free? Right?
Hmm hmm hmm hmm, hmm hmm hmm♪ ...Ehehe. Did you see the stars outside? They were so pretty I wanted to sing.
There's no dress code for cherry blossom viewing... right? It's an invite from Fine... Ugh, I can't mess this up...
I can't stand the heat, sure, but I can't stand the AC being too strong either. Glad I brought a cardigan.
Sweet potatoes, hmm hmm♪ Chestnuts, pumpkins! Hmm hmm♪ Autumn's so nice, so yummy~♪
I agonize over a 1,000-yen lunch, but I'll buy 1,500-yen warm socks without a second thought. That's me, Hishi Miracle!
I changed my hairstyle, too, so let's take it nice and easy.
Huh?! You're making a cheer song for me?! Wh-what...? I-I'm happy, but isn't that way too embarrassing?
M-maybe it's 'cause my earmuffs are wool? I can't hear very well. ...Did you just say we're going all out?
Since I'm all dressed up... after training, wanna go to our usual okonomiyaki place?
This outfit is super cute, but... with my average aura, will people even think I'm an active racer?
I-is it just me? Lately people keep coming up to say they're my fans... Could it be... the fashion effect?!
It's not the fashion effect or a miracle... They're expecting things from us, aren't they? Everyone... from you and me.
Our harmony of hard work really rang out!
Ehehe... I'm in a good mood. Shall we sing?
Hehe, wanna go for one more song?
The harmony of sweat and tears is now in full bloom! ...Just kidding.
Ah-ah♪ Oh, yes! It's Hishi Miracle.
Clothes you bought with friends are "special" just because of that, right?
I can feel my braids swaying~

I can feel my braids swaying~
Not a little autumn, but a little miracle! ...Wanna go find one?
Even if it's small, it's still a miracle!
Now, now. Relax your shoulders once in a while! Take it eeasy... Oh! Hehe... Here's a miracle for you♪
Wh-whoa?! I did it! Do I get a reward?!
Eek! I actually won! Me!
I'm kind of the type who tries things on. Not that it matters.
Huh? Is it fraying...? Nope. Phew.
I'm kind of the type who tries things on. Not that it matters.
Huh? Is it fraying...? Nope. Phew.
You're picking me? You've got weird taste.
You're totally fired up. ...Guess I'll catch some of that!
Stuff like this is actually pretty fun once you do it. Best of all, it eats up class time! Ehehe♪
I'm totally gonna be sore tomorrow! But I think it was a good memory, right? The afterparty was fun♪
I did choir back in elementary school... but I've forgotten everything I learned! Sorry, music teacher...
All my friends were like, "Mira-ko snapped?! That's rare!" ...Ugh, I'm thinking the same thing about myself.
No being lazy—I'll get it dry-cleaned properly when the seasons change! ...I want to take good care of this outfit.
Happy Valentine's Day!
Happy Valentine's Day!
Good work today.
Yeah, let's do our best.
These are just my normal hanging-out clothes.
Cute in moderation, I guess.
Yeah, let's do our best!
Yay!
Hmhm~
Hmhm~
Ehehe.
Ehehe.
Ahaha.
Ahaha.
Ahaha.
